usage: The phrase is used to provide a summary or general assessment of a situation after considering all details.
It often appears at the beginning of a statement to frame the speaker's overall opinion or conclusion.
It helps to signal that the speaker is giving a broad, comprehensive view rather than focusing on specifics.
This phrase is common in both formal and informal contexts when summarizing discussions, reports, or observations.
Use it to transition from specific points to a general final judgement.
